industry_updates.detail: Vertiv reports Q3 before US market open on Oct 28 (earnings call 11:00 US Eastern), with company guidance of adjusted EPS $1.77~$1.83; Carrier and Trane report Q3 before market open on Oct 29, with Trane market-expected EPS of about $4.74 and revenue of about $6.4~$6.5 billion; Midea's board reviews its Q3 report on Oct 29.
industry_updates.title: Earnings window: Vertiv today, Carrier / Trane / Midea tomorrow

industry_updates.detail: Launched at Chillventa 2026, the H-Pack indoor heat pump needs no outdoor unit (modular, remote diagnostics, all-electric / hybrid); PortaSplit is planned to switch to R290 in 2027; Midea won Euromonitor's global No. 1 residential inverter air conditioner and No. 1 R290 air conditioner (fourth consecutive year).
industry_updates.title: Midea Europe heat-pump launches: H-Pack indoor heat pump, PortaSplit switching to R290 in 2027

industry_updates.detail: Closed-loop liquid-to-gas CDU with up to 260 kW per rack, able to retrofit existing air-cooled data halls without changing piping or raised floors; redundant pumps / fans / sensors / controllers, 50-micron filtration, hot-swappable.
industry_updates.title: Delta GoCool-260 rack-level liquid-cooling CDU

industry_updates.detail: Motivair hybrid WCDU: up to 3.5 MW per unit, up to 20 units networkable to cover 30-40 MW data halls, approach temperature difference as low as 2°C; shipments begin in some regions from October, US pre-orders open in early 2027.
industry_updates.title: Schneider WCDU enters delivery phase

industry_updates.detail: At the Chillventa Congress, Daikin's Europe representative said Lot 1 coverage will expand to products below 1 MW (including IT and process cooling); 5 new test methods are coming, and load-based testing for heat pumps below 70 kW becomes mandatory within 4 years, with all models requiring retesting.
industry_updates.title: EU efficiency regulation Lot 1 expands to 1 MW, all models to be retested within 4 years

siphon_effects.change: Channel prices diverge from standard benchmarks: DigiKey channel lead times for some Samsung Electro-Mechanics part numbers are 61 weeks (October, delivery around end-2027) and still high; Emerald Q4 benchmarks show standard resistors / ceramic capacitors stable at 8-12 weeks, but high-capacitance / high-voltage MLCCs at 18-24 weeks and lengthening, some on allocation.

TrendForce benchmarks: DRAM lead times 20 weeks, NAND 16 weeks, continuing; Sourceability Q3 report: some Micron technology lead times reach 52 weeks, enterprise SSDs from multiple vendors on allocation, lead times 24-52 weeks and lengthening.

Emerald Q4 benchmarks: high-performance MCUs and dedicated PMICs at 22-28 weeks and above and lengthening; MOSFETs and high-voltage power discretes approaching 26 weeks, trend lengthening; A2 Global Q4 warning continues (Infineon order delays, Altera allocations for long-standing customers 40%-60%).

LME copper closed overnight at $14,338/ton, +0.28% (SMM Oct 27 morning meeting); Oct 27 session copper around $14,370/ton; LME 3M aluminum reported $3,085/ton on Oct 27, +1.5%, a fresh high in over two weeks, helped by 3,500 tons of Asian warehouse withdrawal registrations.

supplier_updates.detail: No new quotations, continuing Oct 21 benchmarks: R22 ex-factory RMB 19,500/ton leading declines, R32 and R134a each RMB 65,000/ton stable; third-generation quota 797,800 tons, top six enterprises accounting for over 90%.

Emerald Q4 update (Oct 23): high-capacitance / high-voltage MLCCs at 18-24 weeks and lengthening, some on allocation, standard parts stable at 8-12 weeks; DigiKey channel lead times for some Samsung Electro-Mechanics part numbers still high at 61 weeks.

TrendForce benchmarks: DRAM lead times 20 weeks, NAND 16 weeks, continuing; Sourceability Q3 report: some Micron technology lead times reach 52 weeks, enterprise SSDs from multiple vendors on allocation, lead times 24-52 weeks and lengthening.

MOSFETs / high-voltage discretes approaching 26 weeks (Emerald, Oct 23); high-performance MCUs / dedicated PMICs at 22-28 weeks and above; Siemens DI China price adjustment effective Nov 01, 4 days to go; no new letters from Infineon / onsemi, A2 warning continues.
Nexans cable capacity bottleneck continues; PCIe 6.0 / CXL connector lead times continue at 36 weeks.
No new price-increase letters (Embraco Oct 19 effective date continues).
